# Errors

Generated by `inference-docs` from the compiled ESS specification (`ess specify compile --path ess --format json`). There are 56 error kinds in 8 domains. Each is a refusal: the command it answers changed nothing. The code names each one, as an enum variant or a type, in the file the last column links; the generator refuses a kind no source file names.
